title: Multisubject, multimodal face processing
description: A multimodal neuroimaging dataset comprising structural MRI, functional MRI, MEG, and EEG recordings from 16 subjects during a face recognition task. The dataset includes three stimulus categories (famous faces, unfamiliar faces, and scrambled faces) presented in initial and repeated conditions, enabling investigation of neural mechanisms underlying face processing and repetition effects across multiple imaging modalities.
methods_description: Data were acquired using a multi-modal protocol including high-resolution structural MRI (MPRAGE), blood oxygen level-dependent fMRI, MEG recordings with digitized anatomical fiducials (nasion and bilateral ears), and EEG. MEG-MRI alignment was performed using three anatomical fiducials. The fMRI task involved presentation of famous faces, unfamiliar faces, and scrambled faces in initial and repeated (immediate and delayed) conditions with specific trigger codes for each stimulus category.
